name: Onion
description: The base of nearly every gravy on earth.

histamine.note: Well tolerated; raw excess bothers some stomachs (not histamine).

nutrition.highlight: quercetin sits in the papery outer layers

guna.note: Onion and garlic are the classic exclusions from a sattvic diet — stimulating rather than clarifying, which is why temple and monastic cooking leaves them out.
